result.instructions: Tools for Customer.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Customer.io data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run customerio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run customerio_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run customerio_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. customerio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: customerio_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Search/list people by a Customer.io filter (segment or attribute conditions). e.g. filter={"segment":{"id":7}} or {"and":[...]}. App API: POST /v1/customers.

start.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's `next`.

tools.name: customerio_get_customer_attributes
tools.title: Get customer attributes
tools.description: Get a single person's attributes (profile fields). App API: GET /v1/customers/{customer_id}/attributes.

customer_id.description: The person's id (or cio_id / email, per your identifier setup).

tools.name: customerio_get_customer_segments
tools.title: Get customer segments
tools.description: List the segments a single person belongs to. App API: GET /v1/customers/{customer_id}/segments.

tools.name: customerio_get_customer_messages
tools.title: Get customer messages
tools.description: List messages (deliveries) sent to a single person. App API: GET /v1/customers/{customer_id}/messages.

start.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's `next`.

tools.name: customerio_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List all segments in the workspace (id + name + type). App API: GET /v1/segments.

tools.name: customerio_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List all campaigns in the workspace. App API: GET /v1/campaigns.

tools.name: customerio_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: Get a single campaign by id. App API: GET /v1/campaigns/{campaign_id}.

tools.name: customerio_get_campaign_metrics
tools.title: Get campaign metrics
tools.description: Get delivery/engagement metrics for a campaign over time. App API: GET /v1/campaigns/{campaign_id}/metrics.

type.description: Metric type filter (e.g. email, push, sms).

tools.name: customerio_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List sent messages (deliveries) across the workspace, filterable by type/campaign/newsletter. App API: GET /v1/messages.

start.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's `next`.

type.description: Message type filter, e.g. email | push | sms | in_app | webhook | slack | twilio.

tools.name: customerio_list_exports
tools.title: List exports
tools.description: List data exports in the workspace. App API: GET /v1/exports.

tools.name: customerio_list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: List reusable data collections in the workspace. App API: GET /v1/collections.

tools.name: customerio_send_transactional_email
tools.title: Send transactional email
tools.description: ⚠️ SENDS A REAL EMAIL. Send a transactional email using a transactional message template. Delivers immediately to the `to` recipient. App API: POST /v1/send/email.

transactional_message_id.description: The transactional message template id (or trigger name).

message_data.description: Template variables (liquid) to interpolate into the message.

disable_message_retention.description: If true, don't retain the message body.

send_to_unsubscribed.description: If true, send even to unsubscribed recipients.

tools.name: customerio_trigger_broadcast
tools.title: Trigger broadcast
tools.description: ⚠️ SENDS TO REAL RECIPIENTS. Trigger an API-triggered broadcast, delivering to the resolved recipient set. App API: POST /v1/send/broadcast (posts to /v1/campaigns/{broadcast_id}/triggers).

data.description: Liquid variables available to the broadcast templates.

recipients.description: Recipient filter object (overrides the broadcast's configured audience).

email_ignore_missing.description: Skip recipients missing an email instead of erroring.

id_ignore_missing.description: Skip recipients missing an id instead of erroring.
